name: disk_usage_monitor_realert_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: DISK_USAGE_MONITOR_REALERT_20261104 — the disk monitor alerts on one clock: the first thing ever said
about a mount is immediate, and after that nothing is said until realert_minutes has passed, so a band that
STAYS bad keeps being reported (a 23-hour critical band used to be one alert and then silence), a flapping band
cannot storm (96 alerts in 24 hours), and a future stamp left by a clock correction is treated as due rather
than as silence. Every band inherits the interval through metric_policy, so a new band cannot be a one-shot.
